Shaggy, charcoal black hair with uneven bangs covering a portion of the forehead. Sharp, piercing amber eyes with a focused, predatory expression. Appears as a mature adult in their prime. Lean, athletic build. Wears a signature dark charcoal and deep grey assassin's garb consisting of a hooded cloak and leather armor. Features a distinctive silver-grey face mask covering the lower half of the face and scarred skin.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
